scope: Predefined validation-only FFN interventions; no model promotion or new test inference

saved_prediction_analysis.scope: Descriptive slices of already evaluated test predictions; small groups are not significance tests

trace_interpretation: Each operator receives the same FP32-trajectory input; normalized RMS errors use unpadded positions. Dynamic versus dequantized-weight FP32 isolates weight rounding from the remaining runtime quantization/kernel path, not activation error alone. Outlier ratios are descriptive, not causal proof.
